issues.display_title: Issue #1869: feat(blog): Blog Management List, Filtering, and Navigation
issues.main_description_html:
Parent PRD

Ref: #1866 ([PRD] Villume Blog Management & Editor)
Goals: #1866 Goals 1, 2, 3

Overview

Implement the administrative Blog Management page (/blog) under the Settings area for Support users, providing complete search, filtering, and pagination over editorial articles.

Scope of Work

  • Routing & Navigation:
    • Add /blog route under Settings navigation accessible to Support users.
    • Page header with action button Create New Article navigating to /blog/create.
  • Search & Filtering:
    • Live search input with 300ms debounce across title, author name, and slug.
    • Category dropdown filter.
    • Status dropdown filter (all, published, draft, unpublished).
  • Article Table:
    • Columns: Cover thumbnail, Title, Category, Author, Status badge (draft, published, unpublished), and Last Updated date.
    • Action menu: Edit article, View live article, Quick Publish, Quick Unpublish, and Delete article.
  • Pagination:
    • Page navigation controls (page, limit, total_pages).
  • Loading & Empty States:
    • Loading spinner indicator during data retrieval.
    • Clean empty state with call-to-action to create an article.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Support users can access the Blog management page from Settings.
  • Search query debounces at 300ms before triggering filter/API request.
  • Articles are filterable by Category and Status.
  • Pagination controls correctly reflect total items and page bounds.
  • Action menu triggers corresponding modals or routes.

issues.display_title: Issue #1870: feat(blog): Article Editor with Editor.js, Inline Images, and SEO Metadata
issues.main_description_html:
Parent PRD

Ref: #1866 ([PRD] Villume Blog Management & Editor)
Goals: #1866 Goals 4, 5, 6 & Additional Feature 1, 3

Overview

Implement the dedicated article editor page (/blog/create and /blog/edit/:id) with rich text capabilities via Editor.js, cover image uploading, inline image tool, tag chips, and SEO metadata configuration.

Scope of Work

  • Dedicated Editor Routes:
    • /blog/create for creating new drafts.
    • /blog/edit/:id for editing existing articles with pre-populated data.
  • Article Header & Slug:
    • Title input that automatically generates a URL-safe slug.
    • Option to manually customize the slug.
    • Live save status indicator (Saved, Saving..., Unsaved changes).
  • Cover Image Dropzone:
    • Drag-and-drop or file picker upload for featured hero image.
    • Validation: 10MB max file size, standard image formats (image/*).
    • Image preview with remove/replace capability.
  • Editor.js Rich Text Integration:
    • Integrated @editorjs/editorjs.
    • Heading block (H2, H3, H4).
    • List block (ordered, unordered).
    • Quote block with author caption.
    • Delimiter block.
    • @editorjs/image tool with custom uploader connecting to backend upload endpoint (POST /v1/support/blog/upload-image) and offline data URL fallback.
  • Taxonomy & Tags:
    • Category selector dropdown with inline button to open category manager.
    • Tag chip input supporting Enter and comma triggers with removal badges.
  • SEO & Metadata Panel:
    • SEO Title (max 70 characters recommendation with counter).
    • Meta Description (max 160 characters recommendation with counter).
    • SEO Keywords input (comma-separated).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Supports creating new articles and editing existing articles.
  • Auto-slug generation preserves manual overrides.
  • Cover image uploads successfully and updates preview.
  • Editor.js supports headers, lists, quotes, delimiters, and inline images.
  • Tags can be added via Enter/comma and deleted individually.
  • SEO fields correctly save and persist to article payload.

issues.display_title: Issue #1871: feat(blog): Category Management with Articles Count and Delete Safety
issues.main_description_html:
Parent PRD

Ref: #1866 ([PRD] Villume Blog Management & Editor)
Goals: #1866 Goal 6 & Additional Feature 4

Overview

Implement comprehensive Category Management modal accessible from both the Blog List toolbar and the Article Editor, allowing users to view, create, edit, and safely delete categories.

Scope of Work

  • Dual-Tab Category Management Modal:
    • Tab 1: All Categories - View all existing categories with slug and articles_count badge (Issue #200).
    • Tab 2: Add / Edit Category - Form for creating or editing category title, slug, and optional description.
  • Edit Category Flow:
    • Ability to click edit icon on any category to prefill the form and update category details (PUT /v1/support/blog/categories/:id).
  • Safe Delete Category Flow:
    • Delete button on category row (DELETE /v1/support/blog/categories/:id, Issue #197).
    • Confirmation dialog with warning banner highlighting the number of assigned articles (articles_count > 0).
  • Synchronized Global State:
    • Triggering category changes updates parent category dropdowns in both list and editor views automatically.
    • Reset active filter if currently selected category was deleted.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Category list displays all categories with article counts.
  • User can add a new category with custom or auto-generated slug.
  • User can edit an existing category.
  • Deleting a category prompts confirmation with a warning when articles are assigned.
  • Blog list and Editor dropdowns immediately synchronize upon category changes.

issues.display_title: Issue #1872: feat(blog): Publishing Workflow, Social Sharing, Analytics, and Backend Integration
issues.main_description_html:
Parent PRD

Ref: #1866 ([PRD] Villume Blog Management & Editor)
Goals: #1866 Goals 7, 8, 9, 10 & Additional Feature 2

Overview

Implement the article publishing lifecycle, publishing status modal, social media share modal, Countly analytics integration, and full Go backend REST API integration.

Scope of Work

  • Publishing Lifecycle Modal:
    • Modal with 3 visual states: Publishing... (spinner), Success (check icon & message), and Error (error explanation & Retry button).
    • Quick action to open Share modal directly from the success state.
  • Social Sharing Modal:
    • Direct copy link to clipboard with visual copied indicator.
    • One-click share buttons for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and WhatsApp.
    • "View Live Article" button opening public URL in a new tab.
  • Go Backend API Integration:
    • Connect to Go endpoints specified in Issues #189 - #203:
      • GET /v1/support/blog/articles (#199)
      • GET /v1/support/blog/articles/:id & GET /v1/blog/articles/:slug (#198, #189)
      • POST /v1/support/blog/articles (#194)
      • PUT /v1/support/blog/articles/:id (#202)
      • DELETE /v1/support/blog/articles/:id (#196)
      • PATCH /v1/support/blog/articles/:id/publish (#201)
      • GET /v1/support/blog/categories (#200)
      • POST /v1/support/blog/categories (#195)
      • DELETE /v1/support/blog/categories/:id (#197)
      • GET /v1/blog/tags (#193)
      • POST /v1/support/blog/upload-image (#203)
    • Bidirectional data normalization (cover_image <-> featured_image, name <-> title, Editor.js JSON data).
    • In-memory & local storage fallbacks for network resilience.
  • Countly Analytics Tracking:
    • Track events: blog_article_created, blog_article_updated, blog_article_published, blog_article_unpublished, blog_article_deleted, blog_category_created, blog_category_updated.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Publishing shows loading, success, and error retry states.
  • Social share dialog generates valid share links and copies URL.
  • Backend Go endpoints are fully integrated with authentication.
  • Countly analytics track key administrative blog events.
  • Offline fallback gracefully caches state locally.

issues.display_title: Issue #1877: feat(blog): condition blog view and navigation for support vs public and non-support accounts
issues.main_description_html:
Background & Problem

In BlogListComponent, the view mode isInsideDashboard is currently evaluated as !!this.mainService.userInfo. As a result, any logged-in user (such as regular artists, collectors, or gallery clients) is presented with the Admin Dashboard view (dash-blog-admin). This causes two issues:

  1. The component attempts to fetch /v1/support/blog/articles via getAdminPosts(), which fails with 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden for non-support accounts.
  2. The UI exposes admin-only controls ("Create Blog", publish/unpublish toggles, edit actions). The "Create Blog" link points to /blog/new, which is protected by authSupportGuard and redirects to /404.

Additionally, the desktop sidemenu currently renders a "Create blog" submenu item for all logged-in users under /blog.

Scope of Work

  1. BlogListComponent (src/app/pages/blog/blog-list/blog-list.component.ts):

    • Inject SupportSessionService.
    • Define isSupportUser: 
      public get isSupportUser(): boolean {
  return this.supportSession.shouldShowSupportMenu(this.mainService.userInfo);
}
    • Condition isInsideDashboard: 
      public get isInsideDashboard(): boolean {
  return this.isSupportUser;
}
    • Update loadData() and applyFilters():
      • When isSupportUser: call blogService.getAdminPosts(filterOptions).
      • When not support (unauthenticated or regular logged-in user): call blogService.getPublicPosts(filterOptions).
    • In blog-list.component.html, ensure the "Create New" hero button in the public view is displayed only if isLoggedIn && isSupportUser.

  2. SidemenuComponent (src/app/layouts/sidemenu/sidemenu.component.ts & .html):

    • Inject SupportSessionService or verify support role on userInfo.
    • Wrap the "Create blog" submenu link with @if (isSupportUser) so non-support logged-in accounts only see the main "Blog" link.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Unauthenticated visitors navigating to /blog see the Full Public Marketing View (The Villume Journal) and consume GET /v1/blog/articles.
  • Logged-in non-support users (e.g. user_type: 'user') navigating to /blog see the Full Public Marketing View without admin controls.
  • Support accounts (user_type: 'support' or active support session) navigating to /blog see the Admin Dashboard view (dash-blog-admin) and consume /v1/support/blog/articles.
  • Non-support logged-in accounts do not see the "Create blog" submenu in the sidemenu.
  • Unit tests in blog-list.component.spec.ts verify correct routing of data fetching and layout based on account type.
  • Project compiles cleanly via pnpm ng build --configuration=development.

Demo by Developer

issues.display_title: Issue #1876: feat(blog): integrate public blog and category endpoints in BlogAdminService and BlogService
issues.main_description_html:
Background & Problem

Currently, BlogService and BlogAdminService use the support endpoint GET /v1/support/blog/articles (Backend Issue GoThruMedia/villume-backend-go#199) indiscriminately for both admin management and public article queries. Because /v1/support/blog/* strictly requires JWT authentication and a support role, unauthenticated visitors and non-support accounts encounter 401 Unauthorized errors when viewing published articles on public views (such as the landing page / and public journal /blog).

The backend has implemented dedicated public endpoints that are excluded from JWT authentication and strictly return published records:

  • GET /v1/blog/articles (Backend Issue GoThruMedia/villume-backend-go#191): Public article listing with pagination and server-side filtering.
  • GET /v1/blog/categories (Backend Issue GoThruMedia/villume-backend-go#192): Public category list with published articles_count.
  • GET /v1/blog/tags (Backend Issue GoThruMedia/villume-backend-go#193): Public deduplicated tags list.

Scope of Work

  1. BlogAdminService (src/app/pages/blog-admin/blog-admin.service.ts):

    • Define interface BlogPublicListParams: 
      export interface BlogPublicListParams {
  page?: number;
  limit?: number;
  search?: string;
  category?: string; // slug or UUID
  tag?: string;
  featured?: string | boolean; // 'true' or '1'
}
    • Implement getPublicArticles(params?: BlogPublicListParams): Observable<BlogListResponse> calling GET /v1/blog/articles.
    • Implement getPublicCategories(): Observable<BlogCategory[]> calling GET /v1/blog/categories.
    • Maintain existing getArticles() and getCategories() for support management calls to /v1/support/blog/*.
    • Provide fallback to local in-memory published articles/categories if request fails or offline.

  2. BlogService (src/app/pages/blog/blog.service.ts):

    • Update getPublicPosts(options?: BlogFilterOptions) to call blogAdminService.getPublicArticles(...).
    • Update getFeaturedPosts(limit?: number) to call blogAdminService.getPublicArticles({ featured: 'true', limit }).
    • Update getRelatedPosts(currentPost, limit?: number) to use blogAdminService.getPublicArticles({ category: currentPost.category }) instead of querying the support endpoint.
    • Update loadCategoriesFromBackend():
      • If user is support (user_type === 'support' || supportSession.hasSupportSession()), fetch from getCategories().
      • Otherwise, fetch from getPublicCategories().

Acceptance Criteria

  • getPublicArticles invokes GET /v1/blog/articles without requiring an Authorization header.
  • Query parameters page, limit, search, category, tag, and featured are serialized correctly.
  • getPublicCategories invokes GET /v1/blog/categories and maps articles_count.
  • Public-facing methods (getPublicPosts, getFeaturedPosts, getRelatedPosts) in BlogService query the public endpoints rather than /v1/support/blog/*.
  • Unit tests in blog-admin.service.spec.ts pass and cover both successful responses and mock fallbacks.

Demo by Developer
